question_text: A workstation has sufficient CPU and GPU power but frequently pages because RAM is full, and loads files from a slow HDD. Explain two hardware upgrades that address these bottlenecks.
adaptation_rationale: Focus precise specified memory/storage bottlenecks rather than generic gaming peripherals. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Add RAM so active model data fits and reduces paging; replace HDD with SSD to speed file I/O and remaining page access.

marking_points.criterion: Links less paging to improved active-workload performance.
Links faster secondary access to loading files or page input/output.
